turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How do I complain about my food without being awkward?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep it calm and specific. Something like, my steak is quite a bit more cooked than I asked for, could it be redone?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I wait until the end of the meal?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No, mention it right away. If you wait, they can't fix it and it looks like you just want money off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What if the waiter gets annoyed?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Most won't, kitchens would rather know. If they do get defensive, you can politely ask for a manager.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm being dramatic when I send things back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sending back a dish that's wrong isn't dramatic. Being rude about it would be, and you clearly aren't planning to.
